title: Align session-list browser badge fixture with production status button markup
outcome: Browser badge fixture applies the real status-button ancestor styles while retaining its direct badge rendering observations.
acceptance: The fixture uses session-row-status-button beside a representative session-row and includes a placeholder icon matching the production structure.
Rendered checks continue to cover nonzero badge dimensions and foreground/background/both/idle styles, with evidence distinguishing direct selector observations from integrated layout.
